Class ImplPlayerBD

java.lang.Object
com.dami.tcg.modelo.ImplPlayerBD
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerDAO
public class ImplPlayerBD extends Object implements PlayerDAO
JDBC-based implementation of the PlayerDAO interface.

Provides concrete database operations for Player entities using direct JDBC connections. Handles player authentication, card inventory management, coin transactions, and free pack availability. Database connection parameters are loaded from the configDB.properties resource bundle.

Author:
Brayan, Adam, Oihan and Asier
